```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment  = "#>",
  eval     = FALSE

```

```{r libraries}
# Load BioDyn package
# Install from the source package on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.19055001):
# install.packages("path/to/BioDyn_0.1.0.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(BioDyn)
```

## Introduction

This vignette presents a complete workflow using **BioDyn**.

## Routes 

```{r routes}
# Retrieve the directory containing example dataset included within the package.
# All demo files must be downloaded locally from the BioDyn Zenodo repository, and their file paths must be specified manually.
# Replace "local route" with the local file paths to the downloaded files.


occurrence_file <- "local route"

checklist_file <- "local route"



eco_path <- "local route"

dem <- "local route"

raster_list <- c(
  bio01 = "local route",
  bio12 = "local route",
  Altitude = dem
)


# Optional: Validate that all required files exist using stopifnot() to prevent errors during the workflow.

stopifnot(
  nzchar(occurrence_file),
  nzchar(checklist_file),
  nzchar(eco_path),
  nzchar(dem),
  all(nzchar(raster_list))
)

```

## 1. Load Data and/or Build presence-absence table

```{r load-data}

# Read the occurence dataset.

data_raw <- data.table::fread(
  occurrence_file,
  sep = "\t",
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

```

```{r build-data}

# Use build_data() to combine occurrence records and checklists into a unified dataset and create pseudo-absences.

checklists_raw <- build_data(
  sightings_file  = occurrence_file,
  checklist_file  = checklist_file,
  pres_col        = "presence",
  label_pos       = "Present",
  label_neg       = "Absent",
  sep             = "\t",
)
```

## 2. Filter by eBird effort

```{r filter-ebird}
# Using filter_ebird() you can remove duplicated records and filter by max distance, max observers, max duration and/or protocols.

data_ebird <- filter_ebird(
  data                = data_raw,
  max_distance_km   = 10,
  max_observers     = 10,
  max_duration_min  = 300,
  protocols = c("Stationary", "Traveling"),
  drop_duplicates   = TRUE
)

checklists_ebird <- filter_ebird(
  data                = checklists_raw,
  max_distance_km   = 10,
  max_observers     = 10,
  max_duration_min  = 300,
  protocols = c("Stationary", "Traveling"),
  drop_duplicates   = TRUE
)
```

## 3a. Filter by ecoregion

```{r filter-eco}
# Use filter_ecoregion() to retain records or checklists located within the specified ecoregion boundaries.
# set buffer_km for a buffer around the polygon.
# set interactive = FALSE/TRUE for static or interactive map output.  

data_ecoregion <- filter_ecoregion(
  data                   = data_ebird,
  eco_path          = eco_path,
  lat_col              = "LATITUDE",
  lon_col              = "LONGITUDE",
  pres_col             = "presence",
  pres_label           = "Present",
  buffer_km            = 0,       
  interactive          = F,
  title                = "Data filtered by ecoregion"
)
```

## 3b. Filter by radius

```{r filter-radius}
# Use filter_radius() to retain checklists located within a defined radius around presence observations (radius_km).
# set interactive = FALSE/TRUE for static or interactive map output.

checklists_radius <- filter_radius(
  data          = checklists_ebird,
  lat_col     = "LATITUDE",
  lon_col     = "LONGITUDE",
  pres_col    = "presence",
  pres_label  = "Present",
  radius_km   = 30,
  interactive = F,
  title = "Data filtered by radius"
)
```

## 3c. Create custom segments

```{r interactive-map}
# Use create_segments() to visualize occurrence records on an interactive map and define custom spatial segments.

create_segments(
  data      = data_ecoregion
)
```

```{r filter-polygons}
# Assign records to spatial segments using filter_pol() and the created polygon file.

polygon_path <- "local route"

data_segments <- filter_pol(
  data           = data_ecoregion,
  polygon_path   = polygon_path,
  species_column = "COMMON NAME",
  output_file    = "data_segments.csv"
)

checklists_segments <- filter_pol(
  data           = checklists_radius,
  polygon_path   = polygon_path,
  species_column = "COMMON NAME",
  output_file    = "checklists_segments.csv"
)
```

## 4. Extract date + season

```{r seasons}
# Extract date components using split_dates().

data_seasonal <- split_dates(data_segments)
data_seasonal <- add_season(data_seasonal)

# Assign ecological seasons to each record using add_season().

checklists_seasonal <- split_dates(checklists_segments)
checklists_seasonal <- add_season(checklists_seasonal)
```

## 5. Extract CHELSA and Altitude rasters

```{r rasters}
# Use extract_rasters() to extract environmental variables from raster layers at each observation location and append the extracted variables to the occurrence dataset.

data_enriched <- extract_rasters(
  data           = data_seasonal,
  raster_list = raster_list,
  out_file    = "data_variables_segments.csv",
  lon_col     = "LONGITUDE",
  lat_col     = "LATITUDE"
)

checklists_enriched <- extract_rasters(
  data           = checklists_seasonal,
  raster_list = raster_list,
  out_file    = "data_variables_eco.csv",
  lon_col     = "LONGITUDE",
  lat_col     = "LATITUDE"
)
```

## 6. Plot effort

```{r plot-effort}
# Use plot_effort() to visualize the spatial-temporal distribution of sampling effort.

p <- plot_effort(checklists_seasonal)

```

# 7. Plots data using ggplot library

# 7a. Latitude / Number of records

```{r plots-latitude}

# Density plot of latitudinal distribution of all records

breaks_lat <- seq(-34, -2, by = 2)

ggplot(data_enriched, aes(y = LATITUDE)) +
  geom_density(aes(x = after_stat(count)), fill = "grey", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_lat) +
  labs(x = "Number of records", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal()

# Density plot of latitudinal distribution of records filtered by season

data_season <- data_enriched |>  filter(season %in% c("Summer", "Winter"))

ggplot(data_season, aes(y = LATITUDE, color = season, fill  = season)) +
  geom_density(aes(x = after_stat(count)), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_lat) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "Number of records", y = "Latitude", color = "Season", fill  = "Season") +
  theme_minimal()

```

# 7b. Proportion of records / months per segment

```{r plots-month-seg}

# Histogram of the monthly variation in records by user-defined segments.

frec_prop_long <- data_enriched |> mutate(MONTH = as.integer(MONTH)) |>  count(Segment, MONTH, name = "n") |>
  group_by(Segment) |> mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>  ungroup()

ggplot(frec_prop_long |> mutate(MONTH = factor(MONTH)), aes(x = MONTH, y = prop, fill = MONTH)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Segment, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Proportion of records") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1"  = "#009E73", "2"  = "#009E73","3"  = "#F0E442", "4"  = "#F0E442", 
                               "5"  = "#F0E442", "6"  = "#0072B2", "7"  = "#0072B2", "8"  = "#0072B2",
                               "9"  = "#CC79A7", "10" = "#CC79A7", "11" = "#CC79A7", "12" = "#009E73")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

```

# 7c. Latitude / seasons per segments

```{r plots-lat-seg}

# Boxplot of seasonal variation in latitude of records by user-defined segments

data_season_seg <- data_seasonal |>  mutate(season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")))

ggplot(data_season_seg, aes(x = season, y = LATITUDE, fill = season)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5,  color = "#D55E00") +
  facet_wrap(~ Segment, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Spring" = "#CC79A7", "Summer" = "#009E73", 
                               "Autumn" = "#F0E442",  "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "Season",  y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

```

# 7d. Proportion of records / raster layers 

```{r plots-raster}

# Density plot of seasonal distribution of all records across climate variables.

ggplot(data_season, aes(x = bio01, color = season, fill  = season)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Annual mean temperature (°C)", y = "Proportion of records") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Density plot of seasonal distribution of records across climate variables by user-defined segments.

ggplot(data_season, aes( x = bio01, color = season, fill  = season)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Segment, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Annual mean temperature (°C)", y = "Proportion of records") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#009E73", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# 7e. Altitude / Number of records

```{r plots-altitude}

# Boxplot of seasonal variation in altitude of records by user-defined segments

data_alt_seg <- data_enriched |>  dplyr::mutate(season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")))

ggplot(data_alt_seg, aes(x = season, y = Altitude, fill = season)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",  shape = 18, size = 2.5, color = "#D55E00") + 
  facet_wrap(~ Segment, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Spring" = "#CC79A7", "Summer" = "#009E73", "Autumn" = "#F0E442", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Elevation (m a.s.l.)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))


# Boxplot of seasonal variation in altitude of records by user-defined segments, all in one plot 

elev_table <- elev_minmax(
  dem            = dem,
  polygons       = polygon_path,
  polygon_id_col = "id"
)

data_alt <- data_enriched |>  mutate(Segment = factor(Segment),  
                              season  = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")))
elev_table2 <- elev_table |> mutate(poly_id = as.character(poly_id))
elev_table2$seg_num <- match(elev_table2$poly_id, levels(data_alt$Segment))
seg_half_width <- 0.35

ggplot(data_alt, aes(x = Segment, y = Altitude, fill = season)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), staplewidth = 1, outlier.size = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 1.8, color = "#D55E00", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_segment(data = elev_table2, aes(x = seg_num - seg_half_width, xend = seg_num + seg_half_width, y = elev_max, yend = elev_max),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = elev_table2, aes(x = seg_num - seg_half_width, xend = seg_num + seg_half_width, y = elev_min, yend = elev_min),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Spring" = "#CC79A7", "Summer" = "#009E73", "Autumn" = "#F0E442", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Elevation (m a.s.l.)", limits = c(0, 7000), breaks = seq(0, 7000, by = 1000)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Population") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", aspect.ratio = 1)

# General altitude data.

alt_stats <- list(mean = mean(data_enriched$Altitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
                  sd   = sd(data_enriched$Altitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
                  n    = sum(!is.na(data_enriched$Altitude)))
alt_stats$se <- alt_stats$sd / sqrt(alt_stats$n)

t_val <- qt(0.975, df = alt_stats$n - 1)
alt_ci <- c(lower = alt_stats$mean - t_val * alt_stats$se, upper = alt_stats$mean + t_val * alt_stats$se)

alt_stats
alt_ci

```
